title: fills of non-planar loops: a pillow, a saddle of arcs and lines, a twisted loop, a triangle of splines

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a pillow: arcs rising 5 over each side of a 30 × 20 rectangle

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a saddle: an arc rising 5 along y = 0, an arc dipping 5 along y = 20, lines along x = 0 and x = 30

cases.name: c003

cases.name: c004
